Its weakness is scope: one recoverable anchor can establish a local structural improvement, not general superiority of editing or structural breadth.

Supply the parent and existing handoff evidence, preserve its pre-lift logic, and permit post-lift control-flow changes; evaluation must remain fully autonomous without expert handoffs. Compare 24 numerical candidates from the unchanged parent against 24 from the edited structure, including each starting vector. Before the LLM call, freeze logs/assembly_targeted_edit_s3420/manifests/assembly-v2_development_s3420.yaml: probe cases 0–4 and promotion cases 10–39. Screen only each arm's probe-selected winner; do not expose new probe or screen outcomes to the LLM or access final-test.

Prediction: metric=paired_success_difference, direction=increase, threshold=0.10, against=24-candidate numerical search of the unchanged recoverable D-020 parent. Report the case-paired t interval on the 30 promotion cases; promote only with a strictly positive lower bound, never on tied success.

falsified_by: the upper paired confidence bound for edited-minus-parent success is below 0.10. An interval spanning both zero and 0.10 is inconclusive; the resolving measurement is the same matched contrast using an independently generated placement edit on a fresh development manifest. An interval containing zero is never evidence of improvement.

Budget at most 300 simulator episodes: 2×24×5 probe episodes plus 2×30 promotion episodes. Use one gpt-6.1-sol edit call and at most one validity-correction call, reasoning_effort=high and temperature=1; retain an invalid edit slot without resampling. Run through gpu run, keep the allocation up during the session, and stop it when the session ends.
